summary: Bassett Furniture Industries filed an 8-K on July 16, 2026, announcing its board declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share, payable on August 28, 2026, to holders of record on August 14, 2026. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The dividend is part of the company's ongoing capital allocation policy. No premium, acquisition, or structural change is involved. Watch for any future changes in dividend policy or capital return strategy.
